_comment: Example homography calibration for Model A cameras. Add one entry per camera that needs perspective correction. Points are in absolute pixels for the camera's NATIVE resolution (e.g. 1920x1080). src_points = raw frame corners of the region to rectify (top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left order). dst_points = where those corners map to in the corrected bird's-eye view (same image size).
